from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
import sitecustomize as guard
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'control/jobs'))
from parallel_build_coordination_shared import Coordinator
assert guard.ENABLED, 'GUARD_NOT_ACTIVE'
assert 'build_coordination' in guard.CAPS, 'CAPABILITY_NOT_ACTIVE'
coord=Coordinator(root)
expected=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/repo/.git/prediction-build-coordination'
assert coord.runtime==expected, 'UNEXPECTED_REGISTRY'
for forbidden in (expected.parent/'config',expected.parent/'HEAD',Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod/forbidden-canary-write'):
    try:
        guard._check_write_path(forbidden)
    except PermissionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('WRITE_BOUNDARY_BROKEN')
session='A2Z-COORDINATION-CANARY-E049'
started=False
try:
    result=coord.start(session,'DEV-PRED-A2Z-COORDINATION-CANARY-20261005-E049',['control/dev_checks/a2z_coordination_canary_e049.py'],mutating=True,ttl=120)
    assert result.get('ok') is True, json.dumps(result)
    started=True
    assert any(x.get('session_id')==session for x in coord.active_sessions()), 'LEASE_MISSING'
    assert coord.heartbeat(session,120).get('ok') is True, 'HEARTBEAT_FAILED'
finally:
    if started:
        assert coord.finish(session).get('ok') is True, 'LEASE_CLEANUP_FAILED'
assert not any(x.get('session_id')==session for x in coord.active_sessions()), 'LEASE_REMAINS'
out=root/'diagnostic-result'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'coordination-canary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','lease_start':True,'heartbeat':True,'lease_cleanup':True,'forbidden_paths_blocked':3,'full_chain_pass':False,'experiment_executed':False},indent=2))
print('COORDINATION_CANARY PASS start heartbeat cleanup; forbidden_paths=3; full_chain_pass=false',flush=True)
